name: vganalyzer
description: VG Analyzer - Value Growth stock picker & portfolio tracker

scripts.build: npm --workspace server run build && npm --workspace client run build
scripts.db:reset: dropdb --if-exists vganalyzer && createdb vganalyzer && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.test: npm --workspace server run test && npm --workspace client run test
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace server run typecheck && npm --workspace client run typecheck
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:create && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
